remarks: Amazing and sophisticated totally furnished townhome in the Turn of River neighborhood with a unique open floor plan custom designed by the owner for gracious entertaining. Nearby shopping, restaurants, and two supermarkets. Very close to the Merritt Parkway Exit 35, High Ridge Road.    The primary bedroom bath is an award-winning design, complete with shower, steam room, sauna, and a special designed toilet/bidet combination. Plenty of closet space with two separate closets. West facing windows for bright afternoon sun.   The second bedroom faces east, with its own entry to the hall bath with tub and shower.   This property is an excellent choice, for example, a C-Suite person who needs to spend a year in Stamford and environs or NYC with an easy commute to the City on MetroNorth Railroad's 50 minute train ride, or less than 40 miles diving to Manhattan.   On the balcony through sliders from the living area not only has a gas barbecue grill, there's a gas fire pit for outdoor entertaining.   Make this your home for a year -- completely and tastefully furnished.
